eligibility.unit_scope: arm-local assigned units; no cross-arm unit matching
eligibility.bootstrap_policy: freeze each arm's full-W3 eligible unit set for every draw

comparisons.delta_orientation: first arm rho minus second arm rho

decisions.meaningful_first_arm_advantage: delta_rho >= 0.05, 95% CI lower bound > 0, and directional yield/ISI guardrails pass
decisions.practical_equivalence: entire 95% delta-rho CI lies within [-0.05, 0.05] and symmetric yield/ISI guardrails pass
decisions.undefined: report unresolved rather than substituting zero

interpretation: Arm-local W3 continuity transfer proxy; does not replace the existing exact-lattice versus static ADVANCE endpoint and does not establish identity or purity.
